title: Sentsa Africa
subtitle: Financial insights platform
description: A financial insights platform that helps unlock data-driven financial intelligence. Built with a dark-mode-first design, green accent theming, and a focus on making complex financial data accessible and actionable.
problem: Financial data is often siloed across spreadsheets, banking apps, and accounting tools. Small businesses and financial teams need a unified view of their financial health without the complexity of enterprise financial software.
role: Built the complete web platform including data visualization, financial analytics dashboards, and the responsive frontend with dark mode support and theme customization.
approach: Next.js with dark mode as the default design direction. Green accent color system for data visualization. Cloudflare Web Analytics for performance monitoring. Responsive design optimized for both desktop analysis and mobile quick-glance views.
hardestDecision: Designing financial data visualizations that are informative without being overwhelming — finding the right level of detail for dashboards that serve both quick daily checks and deeper monthly reviews.
outcome: Live at sentsafrica.com. Provides financial insights and data analytics for businesses seeking a unified view of their financial health.
whatIdChange: Would add automated bank statement imports, implement budget forecasting models, and add team collaboration features for shared financial reviews.
